title: Curve in on the square pass
text: What do you do as the pass travels?
tip: A pass across their back line is a cue to press. Curve your run to block the pass behind you.

options.why: You might get there, but run straight and he can pass into the player behind you.
A long square pass is your chance. Wait and they get it under control.

options.text: Curve your run to one side
options.why: The look showed a long pass across and a player behind you. Curve in from his inside so he can't pass into that player.

scan.prompt: The ball's being passed across their back line. Look before you go.
